2026-11-26.restoration: incremental chain continuation over the extras files on main up to 2026-11-25, generated by gen_chain.py (fallback=None: no ledger-rebuild estimates added by this generator). Elo was advanced from each horse's latest prior appearance file by the repo's own _elo_apply over confirmed results in the stored-details corpus. GUARD (2026-11-12 handover) applied in incremental.py post_appearance_value: horses with no elo in the seed file of their latest appearance stay elo-missing (no ELO_INIT-fallback post values); verified after generation by verify_chain_output.py (guard_ok=true, 0 violations, no Banei races). Details refresh on the night of 2026-11-25: the production API (kraiz-api) returns HTTP 500 (retired after the GitHub-only migration), so fetch_details.py could not run; instead the result-less cached 2026-11-25 cards were deleted and restored from main's result-ingested static packs (arvexq/ui/static/api-static/race/, 36/36 races with confirmed finishers), and the 2026-11-26 cards (48 races: Nagoya 12, Sonoda 12, Urawa 12, Kanazawa 12) were built from main's immutable fallback racecard file (arvexq/ui/static/racecards/2026-11-26.json) with each horse's past runs assembled from the stored corpus only (its latest appearance's recorded past-run lines plus that appearance's confirmed result prepended; 532 horses, 455 with past runs, 77 with none — no estimated runs). Trial supplement (trial_supplement.py): 63 debutants found, 0 supplemented (no official trial pass records found; Nankan records HTTP 403 and Sonoda detail pages 404 as previously known). Banei (Obihiro) excluded as always.
2026-11-26.speedMethod: build_speed_adjusted recomputed over the stored details corpus (real recorded runs only); pool is smaller than the original export's, so spd values may differ slightly from the original export

trialSpd2Supplements.method: spd2 conversion identical to the production yardstick (shadow_v8.build_speed_adjusted over the same speed pool gen_chain.py used): par = median of all pool race times at (track, surface, distance) dated strictly before the trial date (>= 5 samples); raw = trial_time - par; when the trial day's own variant stands, value = raw - variant (form=variant-adjusted), otherwise value = raw (form=raw-no-variant). spd2_recent = spd2_best = the single trial value. Elo is never derived from trials.
trialSpd2Supplements.principles: pass rows of official ability trials only （能力試験/能力検査/能力審査）; conversion only where races exist at the same track/surface/distance; unfound or unconvertible horses stay unsupplemented and are listed with reasons; JRA first starters out of scope (no ability-trial system); banei excluded

trialSupplementReapplication.description: Chain-restored extras (gen_chain.py incremental chain continuation; all Elo/spd chain values unchanged from the chain output) plus a re-applied ability-trial supplement. The originally placed file (commit 2ace893) was generated before the trial-cache merge and therefore carried 0 supplements (the Nankan source is unreachable over plain HTTP: 403). On 2026-11-25, 378 Nankan ability-trial pass records collected via the cloud browser from nankankeiba.com shiken_list (10 sessions, 2026-09-18 to 2026-11-25) were merged into the trial cache (57 -> 435 records) and trial_supplement.py was re-run against the merged cache (--no-fetch): 5 Urawa debutants supplemented with trial-derived spd2 (spd2_recent = spd2_best). No other entry differs from the chain output.
